description: Six broad and weekly Portuguese/English searches returned no confirmed in-window protest report. Search responses repeatedly surfaced newer election-related unrest or unrelated security/insurgency coverage; the engine’s date-window behavior was unreliable. This is not evidence that no protest occurred.
required_followup: Search February 2023 using direct local outlets and regional/source-specific queries; check publication and event dates in bodies before coding.

description: The first pass was weighted toward Maputo, with limited mentions of Beira/Nampula/Quelimane. It did not systematically cover every province, municipality, labor sector or student/community organization.
required_followup: Continue region-by-region and sector-specific Portuguese/English searches and record actual returned evidence.

description: Portuguese and English were searched; no searches in Changana, Emakhuwa or other local languages were performed in this bounded checkpoint.
required_followup: If feasible, search local-language terms or local-language outlets; otherwise retain this coverage gap.

description: Open-web searching is not Lexis-Nexis-equivalent and cannot support a no-events/exhaustive-coverage claim. Official baseline/universe and Polity code mapping remain unresolved.
required_followup: Coordinator baseline gate remains pending; continue independent searches and event continuity checks.

description: A search result described a 14-Feb UP-Maputo student petition about tuition/fees; it is a legal filing, not a public gathering. No event candidate is retained from it.
required_followup: If new reporting identifies a contemporaneous student assembly/march, assess that separate action; do not treat the petition itself as protest attendance.

description: Search-only Ikweli report describes a 14-Feb manifestation by Malema municipal police agents, giving a count of 15 agents and mentioning additional OJM members without number; public assembly and 50-person threshold are unverified. Exact body request returned tool-level inaccessible response without HTTP status/content.
required_followup: No retry/variant on this exact story. Seek independent permitted local reporting if available to establish whether a public gathering occurred, site-specific turnout and state target.

description: O País body verifies workers demonstrated in front of the Namaacha municipal building almost a month after Jan 6, but gives no exact day or turnout. The likely date interval may straddle late January/early February, so onset-month assignment and relation to the earlier work stoppage remain unresolved.
required_followup: Preserve pending_unit until a source gives a date precise enough to assign onset month; do not infer attendance or physical end from the Mayor’s statement that workers returned to work.

description: Feb 16 Ikweli search result quotes a participant claiming the demand was made by 100 employees during the Malema manifestation; the exact body open returned only the host/URL with Total lines: 0. It remains unclear whether 100 means simultaneous public attendees or the broader group of strikers.
required_followup: Do not retry this URL or variants. Seek independent permitted reporting with site-specific crowd attendance; do not treat the search-only number as a verified attendance count.
